title: The Lamprey Field Sampling Kit: A Protocol for Plankton Biomass DNA Sampling
author: Erwan Legeay

steps.title: Prepare reagents and equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary solutions and ensure the power source is ready.

substeps.instruction: Prepare bleach solution to fill the dedicated 15 mL tube.
Prepare filtered seawater (FSW) to fill the dedicated 15 mL tube and the 150 mL squeeze bottle.
Clean the tweezers.
Ensure that the battery is fully charged.

steps.title: Assemble the filter-holder support
steps.instruction: Assemble the Lamprey v4.0 filtration system components.

substeps.instruction: Open the case and remove components.
Assemble the filter-holder support.
Place all components in their designated positions.
Install the Rocker MF 3pro 47mm magnetic filter holder (consisting of funnel lid, 300mL magnetic funnel, magnetic support base, and silicone stopper) on the support.

steps.title: Connect the pump
steps.instruction: Connect the filter holder to the peristaltic pump using the specified pipe.

substeps.instruction: Position the outlet pipe outside the case.
Direct the outlet into a waste container or a bottle to collect filtrate (e.g., filtered seawater).

steps.title: Configure power supply
steps.instruction: Power the pump using either the battery or mains supply.

substeps.instruction: For battery use: Connect the 12V Lithium battery (housed in a waterproof box) to the pump and ensure the button is set to ON.
For mains supply: Disconnect the battery and connect the pump using an appropriate cable and converter (220V transformer outputting 12V).

steps.title: Prepare the filter membrane
steps.instruction: Install the filter membrane while maintaining sterility and correct orientation.

substeps.instruction: Wear gloves and keep them on throughout the procedure.
Open the filter holder and spray FSW onto the support screen using the squeeze bottle to wet it.
Using clean tweezers, remove a filter-membrane from its box.
Place the membrane onto the filter holder, ensuring the side that faced up in the box also faces up on the support and that it lies flat without folds.

steps.title: Filter the plankton sample
steps.instruction: Process the sample through the filtration system.

substeps.instruction: Carefully close the magnetic filter holder without the lid.
Gently stir the plankton sample to ensure homogeneity.
Pour the sample into the funnel using a graduated cylinder.
Turn on the peristaltic pump (rotation 300 rpm, flow rate 700mL/min).
Perform filtration in 100 mL aliquots, stopping if the membrane becomes saturated and clogs.
Record the total volume of the sample poured into the funnel.
Monitor connections and the filter holder for leakages during filtration.

steps.title: Rinse and dry the filter
steps.instruction: Recover remaining particles and dry the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Once the sample is filtered or the filter is saturated, rinse the graduated cylinder and the funnel with FSW from the wash bottle.
Leave the pump running until the filter is completely dry.

steps.title: Preserve the sample
steps.instruction: Transfer the filter to a preservation tube for storage.

substeps.instruction: Switch off the pump and open the magnetic filter holder.
Using tweezers, carefully fold the filter and place it in a tube containing beads and DNA/RNA Shield.
Invert the tube several times to impregnate the entire filter, ensuring the filter remains immersed in the buffer.
Label the tube and store at -20°C for long-term storage.

steps.title: Decontaminate and clean equipment
steps.instruction: Clean the tools and the system to prevent cross-contamination.

substeps.instruction: Clean the tweezers with 10% bleach, then rinse with FSW before using another filter.
Position a container to collect rinse water and rinse the entire filtration system with freshwater.
Fill the system with bleach solution, activate the pump to fill the pipes, stop the pump once full, and wait 10 minutes.
Rinse residual bleach with water (preferably MilliQ water) by activating the pump until as much water as possible is removed.
Clean the surface of the Lamprey, especially areas exposed to seawater.
Ensure the system is completely dry if it will not be used for an extended period.
